guide.text: Converts Batman's Crit Rate into reduced physical damage taken, letting him build up for crits without becoming vulnerable up close. After casting his Ultimate, he calls in an AoE bombing run that deals physical damage to enemies in a circular area, boosting his smoke bomb and Ultimate combo.
